payload.reason: The evidence provides specific information about the extractive models trained on the GameWikiSum dataset.

claims.text: The extractive models trained on the dataset include LEAD-k, TextRank, LexRank, SumBasic, C_SKIP, and SemSentSum.
LEAD-k serves as a strong baseline for single document summarization tasks.
TextRank and LexRank are graph-based methods for extractive summarization.
SumBasic is a frequency-based sentence selection method.
C_SKIP and SemSentSum are near state-of-the-art extractive models that leverage semantics and sentence embeddings.
